_comment: Copy the env block into .claude/settings.local.json at the root of the project you work in (gitignored). Fill the values; leave out variables you do not use. Skills and agents never read .env files. See references/conventions.md for which skill needs which variable.

_notes.AI_SDLC_PROFILE: Profile name; when unset the profile is matched by git remote. Create one with /dev-profile-init.
_notes.JIRA_API_TOKEN: Jira Personal Access Token, not your account password
_notes.JIRA_IN_REVIEW_STATUS: Only needed without a profile: the status name behind the In Review column
_notes.GIT_USERNAME: Short name used in branches; derived from git config user.email when unset
_notes.ADO_*: Only for Azure DevOps repos; ADO_PAT needs Code (Read & Write)
_notes.GITLAB_URL: Instance root, not a project URL
_notes.GITLAB_TOKEN: api scope to open MRs or post comments; read_api is enough for review
_notes.GITLAB_PROJECT: group/subgroup/repo; derived from origin when unset
_notes.PRE_PR_VERIFY_CMD: Optional single command replacing the pipeline-derived pre-flight plan
